text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Oguri Cap, Mejiro Ardan,
and Inari One. A truly star-studded lineup has gathered for this year's Mainichi Okan.
(WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Well, if things go as expected, it'll probably be Oguri Cap.
Her comeback race at the All Comers
showed everyone she's in top form!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
No way, today's definitely Mejiro Ardan's day to win.
Seeing how she ran at Chukyo the other day convinced me she's got this.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: I wonder how well Inari One will measure up. She was in great shape at the Takarazuka Kinen and got called a 'menacing Umamusume,' but—

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: "Even so, Oguri will win! No matter how strong the opponent, Oguri will definitely pull it off again!"

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
—From here on begins Inari One's true battle.
Make sure you hype it up to the fullest... this year's Twinkle Series...!

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
And please, show us a dream...
Show us the further possibilities of this era...!

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—A star-studded lineup has assembled
for this year's Mainichi Okan—"

text_block_list.name: Downtown Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap is crazy strong, right?
Is Inari-chan gonna be okay?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry!
I know for sure you're gonna win, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: —Don't you dare chicken out.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh.
The hype's practically on the level of a GⅠ, ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You heard? The buzz seems to be
about "how well I can hang" with Oguri and the others.
choice_data_list: Let's turn our reputation right around!
Let's just turn those rumors upside down!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!
We're gonna set off a massive boom
right before the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: “—Behold my run, into which I have wagered everything.”
(WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Ardan... She looks gentle and delicate, but
her running carries an unbelievable, hidden resolve.
A true Mejiro horse girl—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What incredible spirit, as expected.
They're a more than worthy—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(What in the world?!
What's with this insane pressure――)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on... your support.
(WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oguri...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "...As expected. It's so tremendous... it inspires a sense of awe."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Heh, broke into a cold sweat there.
Never thought Oguri would be in such insane shape right now—)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Inari.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Let's give it our all today.
Let's put on a race that no one will ever forget.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Goes without saying.
Let's make it flashy!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ......I will be the one to win.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh—
Bring it on, I say...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Man, give me a break.
Just talking gives off this crazy chill.
Still, I can't be getting cold feet...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Because you're the one...
I have to beat!"
